items.title: Unify session identity across REST, WebSocket and /intel (one session model)
follow_ups: Tier: P0. Scope: one id type, one store API, one WS endpoint; decide fate of SessionService, GameService and the duplicate in-memory repos.

Architecture review: ADR-0002 (docs/adr/0002-single-session-model.md, status proposed) chose Option A: delete SessionService and GameService, keep app/services/repos.py InMemorySessionStore as the single store, port ws.py and /intel snapshot to uuid session ids via the SessionStore Protocol, remove /api/v1/stream, add shared message-submit helper. data/repos.py deferred to REQ-0005; REQ-0012 may delete it only after REQ-0005. Pattern PAT-ARCH-001 proposed.

Spec drafted (6 work packages, WP-1 helper first; WP-5 deletions after WP-3/WP-4). Awaiting human acceptance of ADR-0002 and PAT-ARCH-001 (both proposed) before implementation. Open question for human: dropping WS 'token' event and in-WS 'cancel' until REQ-0007.

items.title: Real, non-blocking streaming and honest inference health
follow_ups: Tier: P1, needed by the frontend. Evidence: generate_tokens calls sync httpx inside an async generator (blocks the event loop) and emits one 'token'; settings.ollama.stream is unused; the WS path bypasses the FIFO queue so REST and WS can hit Ollama concurrently; cancel cannot stop a running job; model_loaded is hard-coded True.
Scope: Ollama NDJSON streaming via httpx.AsyncClient, one serialized path for REST and WS, cancel mid-stream, real health probe, and a documented WS event protocol (token/done/error/status).
Depends on: REQ-0004, REQ-0006. ADR likely: yes (streaming protocol is a cross-cutting contract with the frontend).
Re-scoped 2026-11-01 as 'The DM talks' (slice 2 of the north star; see REQ-0020 follow-ups). Independent of REQ-0020 and REQ-0021.
Central design question: worker thread to WebSocket token path, either an in-memory channel or incremental store writes.
Missing artifact: no WS contract doc exists (docs/api/ does not exist); the token, done and cancel events must be documented in the spec.
Cancellation mid-stream is in scope. ADR expected.

Size sketch: client stream method M; worker token channel M; WS token, done and cancel events M; frontend token accumulation S; WS contract doc S. Rough LOC: backend 200-300, frontend 80-120, tests 110-150.

Scope: the client sends the character on session create; the backend stores it nullable on the session; the worker adds a character section (name, species, class, level, ability scores with modifiers, HP/AC, conditions) built by pure builders per PAT-ARCH-003, plus the species character_creation_implications when the species id resolves in services['reference']['species'].
Storage: nullable column on the sessions table via a user_version migration (PAT-ARCH-002). The character is immutable for the session's life (no edit endpoint).
Species identity: the frontend stores the species NAME in free-text lineage today. The spec decides between an id-based model with legacy migration and graceful degradation.
ADR expected: character storage shape, species id-vs-name, back-compat.
Out of scope: streaming, summaries, attack tool, campaign/quest/scene state.

Size sketch: schema and repos S; Protocol methods S; REST create-session payload M; prompt builder and worker wiring M; frontend species-id model and legacy migration M; frontend createSession(character) S; integration test M. Rough LOC: backend 150-250, frontend 100-150, tests 80-120.

items.title: The tale remembers: persistent rolling summary of turns that leave the recent-turn window (slice 3)
follow_ups: NORTH STAR slice 3 of 4; see REQ-0020 follow-ups for the north star and the playtest rule.

Depends on REQ-0020 for sequencing only: the sessions-table migration lands character column first, summary column second; coordinate user_version bumps (PAT-ARCH-002). Also shares the prompt builder path.
Latency: the worker shares one _ollama_lock across all Ollama calls, so a summary call can delay the next turn. The spec MUST decide when and how it runs and state the bounded delay.
Known risk: summary quality on an 8B model is unknown. The spec needs a playtest checkpoint before the trigger is fixed.
ADR optional; the architect decides at its turn. The Game Diary frontend is not changed in this slice.
Size sketch: summary column and repos S; summary prompt builder S; worker summarization trigger M; builder integration S; e2e test M. Rough LOC: backend 130-180, frontend 0, tests 80-100.

items.title: The dice are mine: /roll and /attack use the session character's modifiers (slice 4)
follow_ups: NORTH STAR slice 4 of 4. HARD DEPENDENCY on REQ-0020: the tool reads the character from the session.
Ability heuristic (accepted MVP simplification): finesse takes the best of STR and DEX, ranged uses DEX, otherwise STR.
Weapon lookup uses services['reference']['weapons'] (already in the tool default_context). First consumer of the REQ-0019 weapons dataset.
Help text MUST state that proficiency and spell attacks are out of scope. No HP tracking; the stored character is not mutated.
Contract: .github/instructions/tools.instructions.md and PAT-ARCH-004. No ADR expected.
Frontend weapon picker in the dice tray is a separate small WP.
Size sketch: attack tool M; weapon lookup S; ability heuristic S; frontend picker M; e2e test M. Rough LOC: backend 100-150, frontend 50-80, tests 60-100.

Fallback id measurement: 1 id matches the spec's literal srd-2014-/srd-2024- prefix test (srd-2024-social-interaction-ability-checks). Other fallback-style ids use the srd-<slug> form (for example srd-multiclassing-proficiencies, srd-monsters-hit-points). Count and document both forms in the PR note.

Edge cases in app/intelligence/tools/rules.py and scripts/ingest_open5e.py: run() calls reply.rstrip() (around line 129), which fails if generate returns None; _flatten raises KeyError rather than ValueError when desc is missing (around lines 139-142); run(args: str, context: dict) has a bare dict type.

Brittle test: tests/test_rules_wiring.py around line 39 hard-codes 68 species; derive the count from the dataset instead.

Recall/context risks from SPEC-0014 section 4: selection is lexical, so paraphrased questions fall back to training mode. Ollama num_ctx is 4096 but the client sends no num_ctx; if the installed default is 2,048 tokens, set prompts.rules_budget_chars to about 3,000.
